# Data dictionary

*Generated by `scripts/data_dictionary.py`. The daily JSON files are the unmodified output of the lab tool (`scripts/lab/solana-courbes.mjs`); their keys are in French, the tool's language, and are described here in English. Percentages are fractions (0.174 = 17.4 %); SOL amounts are in SOL.*

## `data/pumpfun-16d/<day>.json` (one per UTC day)

| key | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `genere` | str | timestamp of the tool run |
| `fenetre` | list[2] | UTC window [start, end] |
| `coupe` | str | first minute with full data (diagnostic) |
| `dureeSlot` | float | mean slot duration (s) over the day |
| `fenetre3s` | int | number of slots in the 3-second window used for the creator-sell test |
| `couverture` | dict[7] | coverage: minutes expected/read, minutes without source, duplicates lost, unreadable, canary per program |
| `lecture` | dict[7] | what was read: files, lines, transactions, duplicates, bundles, accounts, largest hands |
| `prixSol` | int | SOL price used for dollar conversions |
| `prioLamports` | int | median priority fee (lamports) |
| `coutARSol` | float | cost of a round trip in SOL (fees only) |
| `verifications` | dict[10] | curve-formula checks: swaps, chained, formula OK, max relative deviation, buy-up / sell-down counts, off-chain |
| `verificationsParFamille` | dict[3] | the same per launch family |
| `fraisBps` | list[1] | [fee in bps, swaps checked] |
| `fraisCreateurBps` | list[1] | [creator fee in bps, swaps checked] |
| `familles` | dict[4] | per launch family (pf|SOL = SOL-quoted pump.fun tokens, the paper's universe; pf|SOL|mayhem; pf|autres cotations = other quote tokens; ll|… = LaunchLab) |
| `parHeure` | list[24] | 24 rows: hour, tokens born, no-trade share, second-buyer share, replay buy 60 s / hold 60 s (r6060) and buy 20 s / hold 160 s (r20180): n, robust mean, mean, median |
| `verificationsLaunchLab` | dict[9] | Raydium LaunchLab: swaps (echanges), chain checks, formula checks, fee checks, fee tiers in bps |
| `sniper` | list[6] | replay at 2 s and 5 s entry: n, marginal mean / robust / median, net of a 0.1 SOL buy |

### `familles["pf|SOL"]["tout"]` (same keys for the other families and for the two half-days)

| key | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `jetons` | int | tokens born |
| `parHeure` | float | tokens per hour |
| `secondAcheteur` | float | share of tokens with a buy from outside the creator within 60 s |
| `secondAcheteurStrict` | float | same, strict (bundle / sniper patterns excluded) |
| `secondStrict001` | float | strict and buy ≥ 0.01 SOL |
| `secondStrict005` | float | strict and buy ≥ 0.05 SOL |
| `gradues` | int | tokens that graduated |
| `echangesMed` | int | median swaps per token |
| `venteTiers` | float | share of tokens with at least one third-party sale |
| `jouablesParHeure` | dict[5] | tokens per hour still alive at E seconds (E = 10, 20, 30, 45, 60) |
| `fouleNonGradues` | list[5] | third-party positions on non-graduated tokens by entry age bucket: positions, SOL paid, strict P&L (stake-weighted), valued P&L, median strict, winners share, never-sold share |
| `fouleGradues` | list[5] | same on graduated tokens |
| `temoinPositif` | dict[3] | positive control: graduated tokens, median price multiple birth → end of curve (theory 14.7), median SOL in the curve at graduation |
| `sansEchange` | float | share of tokens with no swap |
| `foule` | list[5] | same on all tokens (dansGradues = share of positions on graduated tokens) |
| `mainCreateur` | dict[4] | the creator's own trades: tokens, SOL paid, SOL received, P&L |
| `tiers` | list[25] | real third-party buys at entry E and exit H: n, mean, 95 % CI, robust mean, median, winners, median stake, graduated excluded, without dust |
| `rejeu` | list[25] | exact-state replay of a small buy at E sold at H: n, per hour, graduated, marginal (mean, CI, robust, median), net of a 0.005 / 0.01 / 0.05 / 0.1 SOL buy, flow after the buy |
| `venteCreateur` | dict[2] | creator sells ≤ 3 s after an outside buy vs matched control, two definitions (creator; creator + creation slot) |

`familles["pf|SOL"]` also has: `1re moitié`, `2de moitié` (the two halves of the day, same keys as `tout`) and `choixMarcheAvant` (choixMarcheAvant = the cell chosen on the first half and its result on the second).

## `data/pumpfun-16d/crowd_20-60s.csv.gz`

One row per position of the 20–60 s crowd on non-graduated SOL-quoted tokens (1,691,317 rows), no address.

| column | description |
|---|---|
| `day` | UTC day of the token's birth |
| `age_s` | seconds between the token's birth and the position's first buy |
| `paid_sol` | SOL paid (all buys of the position) |
| `strict_pnl` | SOL received ÷ SOL paid − 1, unsold tokens at zero |
| `valued_pnl` | same, unsold tokens at the last curve price |
| `never_sold` | 1 if no sale at all |
| `closed` | 1 if the position was fully closed |

## `data/pumpfun-16d/active_buyers_by_day_ids.csv.gz`

One row per (day, buyer): every address with at least one curve buy that day, as an integer id stable over the 16 days (2,172,420 rows, 1,129,662 ids).

- `data/pumpfun-16d/aggregate-pumpfun.json` — the 16-day aggregate written by `aggregate.py` (fenetre, couverture, jetons, secondAcheteur…, foule2060 = the 20–60 s crowd, fouleTousAgesNonGradues, adresses = distinct / active per day / new per day / 7-day new / retention cohorts, parJour = one row per day, confiance = confidence intervals and tests)
- `data/pumpfun-16d/food-chain-published.json` — the food chain: addresses grouped by positions taken (segments, variant all / nongrad), script and occasional profiles
- `data/pumpfun-16d/users.json` — users and revenue per active buyer, day by day
- `results/robustness_2060.csv` — the robustness variants of the 20–60 s median, day by day (columns named in the header)
- `results/food_chain_recomputed.json` — the food chain recomputed by `scripts/food_chain.py` from the per-position files
- `results/numbers.csv` — the paper's numbers recomputed: id, claim, paper value, recomputed, status A/B/C, result

## Derived CSV files in `data/`

- `data/bots-daily.csv`: `date`, `births_robinhood_1526o`, `births_arc`, `pnl_arc_usd`, `pnl_robinhood_usd`, `median_pool_life_s`, `pct_my_buys_drained`, `event (French, as logged)`, `source`
- `data/launchpads-weekly.csv`: `semaine`, `pump_frais_M`, `autres_launchpads_M`, `total_M`, `part_pump_pct`
- `data/same-clock-weekly.csv`: `semaine`, `pump_frais_M`, `pump_revenu_M`, `pons_frais_M`, `arguspad_frais_M`

`data/bots-daily.csv` is the day-by-day table of the bot campaign (Fig. 2 and Fig. C1 of the paper): births per day of the two factory families, the bots' net dollars, median pool life, share of the author's buys drained, events (in French, as logged).

## `data/raw/`

Unedited API responses: DefiLlama `summary/fees/<protocol>` (`totalDataChart` = [timestamp, value] per day; `totalDataChartBreakdown` = per chain and product), CoinGecko `coins/<id>` and `market_chart` (`prices`, `market_caps` as [ms, value]), `coins/markets` (comparables), Binance `fapi/v1/fundingRate` and `futures/data/openInterestHist`, Hyperliquid `meta`, and the Solscan holder table read by hand on October 22, 2026 (`solscan_pump_holders_2026-10-22.md`).
